To get your API key:
1. Log in to your PromoteKit dashboard.
2. Go to **Settings > API Keys**.
3. Click **Create API Key**.
4. Copy the key and paste it here.

list_affiliates.name: list_affiliates
list_affiliates.description: List all affiliates in your PromoteKit account.

page.description: Page number to retrieve. Defaults to 1.

limit.description: Number of affiliates per page (max 100). Defaults to 10.

aiMetadata.description: Retrieve a paginated list of affiliates in the PromoteKit account. Use to enumerate or browse affiliates rather than look one up by a known ID. Supports page and per-page limit (max 100); read-only and safe to repeat.

find_affiliate.name: find_affiliate
find_affiliate.description: Get details of a specific affiliate by ID.

affiliate_id.description: The ID of the affiliate to retrieve.

aiMetadata.description: Fetch a single affiliate by its PromoteKit affiliate ID. Use when you already have the exact ID and need that affiliate's details; to discover IDs, list affiliates first. Read-only and safe to repeat.

create_affiliate.name: create_affiliate
create_affiliate.description: Create a new affiliate in PromoteKit.

email.description: The email address of the new affiliate.

campaign_id.description: Select the campaign for this affiliate.

aiMetadata.description: Create a new affiliate in PromoteKit, optionally assigning them to a campaign. Email is required; first/last name and campaign are optional. Not idempotent: each call adds another affiliate, so guard against duplicates by checking for an existing affiliate first.

update_affiliate.name: update_affiliate
update_affiliate.description: Update an existing affiliate in PromoteKit.

affiliate_id.description: The ID of the affiliate to update.

payout_email.description: The email address where the affiliate receives payouts.

aiMetadata.description: Update an existing affiliate identified by affiliate ID, changing only the fields you supply (name, payout email, approved, banned); omitted fields are left untouched. Use to approve, ban, or edit an affiliate. Idempotent: re-sending the same field values leaves the affiliate in the same state.

list_referrals.name: list_referrals
list_referrals.description: List all referrals in your PromoteKit account.

page.description: Page number to retrieve. Defaults to 1.

limit.description: Number of referrals per page (max 100). Defaults to 10.

aiMetadata.description: Retrieve a paginated list of referrals (referred customers) in the PromoteKit account. Use to enumerate or browse referrals rather than look one up by a known ID. Supports page and per-page limit (max 100); read-only and safe to repeat.

find_referral.name: find_referral
find_referral.description: Get details of a specific referral by ID.

referral_id.description: The ID of the referral to retrieve.

aiMetadata.description: Fetch a single referral by its PromoteKit referral ID. Use when you already have the exact ID and need that referral's details; to discover IDs, list referrals first. Read-only and safe to repeat.

create_referral.name: create_referral
create_referral.description: Create a new referral in PromoteKit.

email.description: The email address of the referred person.

aiMetadata.description: Create a new referral attributing a referred person (by email) to an affiliate. Both the email and the affiliate ID are required. Not idempotent: each call records another referral, so check for an existing one before repeating.

list_commissions.name: list_commissions
list_commissions.description: List all commissions in your PromoteKit account.

page.description: Page number to retrieve. Defaults to 1.

limit.description: Number of commissions per page (max 100). Defaults to 10.

aiMetadata.description: Retrieve a paginated list of commissions earned in the PromoteKit account. Use to enumerate or browse commissions rather than look one up by a known ID. Supports page and per-page limit (max 100); read-only and safe to repeat.

find_commission.name: find_commission
find_commission.description: Get details of a specific commission by ID.

commission_id.description: The ID of the commission to retrieve.

aiMetadata.description: Fetch a single commission by its PromoteKit commission ID. Use when you already have the exact ID and need that commission's details; to discover IDs, list commissions first. Read-only and safe to repeat.

list_campaigns.name: list_campaigns
list_campaigns.description: List all campaigns in your PromoteKit account.

aiMetadata.description: Retrieve all campaigns (up to 100) in the PromoteKit account, each with its commission type and amount. Use to discover campaign IDs and commission terms, e.g. before assigning an affiliate to a campaign. Read-only and safe to repeat.

find_campaign.name: find_campaign
find_campaign.description: Get details of a specific campaign by ID.

campaign_id.description: The ID of the campaign to retrieve.

aiMetadata.description: Fetch a single campaign by its PromoteKit campaign ID, returning its name and commission terms. Use when you already have the exact ID; to discover IDs, list campaigns first. Read-only and safe to repeat.

list_payouts.name: list_payouts
list_payouts.description: List all payouts in your PromoteKit account.

page.description: Page number to retrieve. Defaults to 1.

limit.description: Number of payouts per page (max 100). Defaults to 10.

aiMetadata.description: Retrieve a paginated list of payouts to affiliates in the PromoteKit account. Use to enumerate or browse payouts rather than look one up by a known ID. Supports page and per-page limit (max 100); read-only and safe to repeat.

find_payout.name: find_payout
find_payout.description: Get details of a specific payout by ID.

payout_id.description: The ID of the payout to retrieve.

aiMetadata.description: Fetch a single payout by its PromoteKit payout ID. Use when you already have the exact ID and need that payout's details; to discover IDs, list payouts first. Read-only and safe to repeat.

instructions.description:
### Setup Instructions

1. Go to your PromoteKit dashboard.
2. Navigate to **Settings > Webhooks**.
3. Click **Add Endpoint**.
4. Paste the webhook URL shown below :
```text
            {{webhookUrl}}
            ```
5. Enable the affiliate event types you selected above.
6. Save the endpoint.

**Need different flows for different events?** Create a separate flow with its own webhook URL, and add a new endpoint in PromoteKit for that flow with only the matching event enabled.

aiMetadata.description: Fires on a PromoteKit affiliate webhook event — when an affiliate is created or approved. Optionally filter to specific event types; leave the selection empty to fire on any affiliate event. Requires the webhook endpoint to be configured in the PromoteKit dashboard.

new_referral_event.name: new_referral_event
new_referral_event.description: Triggers when a PromoteKit referral webhook event is received.

eventTypes.description: Select the referral event types to listen for. Leave empty to receive all referral events.

fr.### Setup Instructions\n\n1. Go to your:
### Instructions de configuration

1. Accédez à votre tableau de bord PromoteKit.
2. Ouvrez **Paramètres > Webhooks**.
3. Cliquez sur **Ajouter un point de terminaison**.
4. Collez l'URL du webhook affichée ci-dessous :
```text

            {{webhookUrl}}
            ```

**Besoin de flux différents pour des événements différents ?** Créez un flux séparé avec sa propre URL de webhook, et ajoutez dans PromoteKit un nouveau point de terminaison pour ce flux avec uniquement l'événement correspondant activé.

### Instructions d'installation

1. Allez dans votre tableau de bord PromoteKit.
2. Allez dans **Paramètres > Webhooks**.
3. Cliquez sur **Ajouter un point de terminaison**.
4. Collez l'URL du webhook affichée ci-dessous :
```text
            {{webhookUrl}}
            ```
5. Activer l'évènement **Commission créée**.
6. Enregistrer le terminal.

### Configurar Instrucciones

1. Ve a tu panel de control de PromoteKit.
2. Navega a **Ajustes > Webhooks**.
3. Haz clic en **Añadir Endpoint**.
4. Pegue la URL del webhook que se muestra a continuación.

5. Activa los tipos de eventos de referencia que seleccionaste arriba.

**¿Necesita flujos diferentes para diferentes eventos? * Crear un flujo separado con su propia URL de webhook, y añadir un nuevo endpoint en PromoteKit para ese flujo con sólo el evento coincidente habilitado.

### Instrucciones de configuración

1. Ve a tu panel de PromoteKit.
2. Navega a **Configuración > Webhooks**.
3. Haz clic en **Añadir endpoint**.
4. Pega la URL del webhook que se muestra a continuación :
```text
            {{webhookUrl}}
            ```
5. Habilita el evento **Commission Created**.
6. Guarda el endpoint.

ja.### Setup Instructions\n\n1. Go to your:
### セットアップ手順

1. PromoteKit のダッシュボードに移動します。
2. **Settings > Webhooks** に移動します。
3. **Add Endpoint** をクリックします。
4. 下に表示されている webhook URL を貼り付けます :
```text
            {{webhookUrl}}
            ```
5. 上で選択したアフィリエイトイベントタイプを有効にします。
6. エンドポイントを保存します。

**イベントごとに異なる flow が必要ですか?** 独自の webhook URL を持つ別の flow を作成し、その flow 用に PromoteKit で新しいエンドポイントを追加して、該当するイベントのみを有効にします。
